item.title: ‘TRUST ME,’ O’NEILL AND THE SEARCH FOR QUALITY RECRUITS
item.description: WITH the clock ticking down to Monday’s 11pm signing deadline, Martin O’Neill insists he is “still very hopeful” of strengthening his Celtic squad. item.title: CELTIC v FC UTRECHT: 5-MINUTE QUIZ
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL is hoping for a Dutch treat at Parkhead this evening when Celtic face FC Utrecht in the Europa League. item.description: Utrecht arrive in Glasgow tonight after five successive defeats, four of them at home. That’s one more than Wilfried Nancy suffered at the start of his month in charge of Celtic. item.title: CONFIRMED: NYGREN IN, IHEANACHO ON BENCH
item.description: BENJAMIN NYGREN gets the nod to take over from banned Reo Hatate against FC Utrecht in the Europa League encounter at Parkhead tonight. The Swede, the Hoops’ top scorer this season with 13 goals, will partner Callum McGregor and Arne Engels in midfield while there is a place among the stand-by squad for Kelechi Iheanacho. [...]

item.title: CELTIC 4 FC UTRECHT 2: DOUBLE DUTCH FOR MARTIN
item.description: CELTIC 4 FC UTRECHT 2 MARTIN O’NEILL and his Celtic players completed a Dutch double to seal their place in tomorrow afternoon’s Europa League knock-out draw.
